story: On the second ascent of the Rua Parque Forestal, Brandon McNulty and Daniel Felipe Martinez attacked, bridging to the early break. The move was neutralised on the final lap, but another acceleration by McNulty split the race again. António Morgado then escaped with Alex Aranburu from the new seven-man break, with Morgado winning the sprint-à-deux.
